messages:
Diego (Finance): Heads up 10 customers reported Feb/Mar embedding variance vs portal. One flagged case: NOVA corp shows 1.9M billed vs 1.3M reported in their portal. Can Billing + SRE triage?
Maya (Billing): filing a ticket for NOVA. Invoice INV-NOVA-202603-01. Do we have the metering query?
Sofia (Support): NOVA attached export with request_ids and timestamps. They say several 429s then client retries; they expect only accepted completions billed.
Omar (SRE): quick triage: our metering increments on acceptance in ingress. However, we had a short window (2026-03-01 00:40-00:55Z) where the ingress service returned 202 early while backend later turned into 500 and the client retried. There was no client_request_id dedupe enforced at that layer.
billing-bot: backfill-job bf-20260301-rewrite started=2026-03-03T04:00Z, status=completed, rows_examined=3,400,112, duplicates_found=587,210
Omar (SRE): from NOVA partition the dedupe pass marked ~600k rows as duplicates. That explains most of the delta. We're still validating token vs embedding mapping because NOVA uses both.
Maya (Billing): estimated dollar impact for NOVA: duplicates 600k * embedding rate $0.000375 = $225.00. For tokens there's a smaller mismatch; need exact token delta to summarize.
Diego (Finance): Rina, request approval to issue credit memo if SRE confirms duplicates. Also please confirm GL code.
Rina (Finance Director): approve provisional credit up to $250 for INV-NOVA-202603-01 pending SRE reconciliation. GL code BILL-ADJ-MAR2026. Note: include root cause and remediation.
Maya (Billing): making provisional credit CM-8220 $225 applied to invoice, status: pending. Adding note: "provisional adjustment for duplicate ingestion during ingress retry window; dedupe job bf-20260301-rewrite; fix deployed commit d3adbeef".
Sofia (Support): replied to NOVA with provisional credit and asked for any additional request_ids to match. Customer said they'd accept credit and wants postmortem.
Omar (SRE): follow-ups: 1) run full cross-customer dedupe scan (job id dedupe-scan-20260304) 2) add alert on ingress early-202 status mismatch 3) schedule audit export for Finance with matched ids restricted by NDA.
Diego (Finance): please aggregate impacted customers into a single reconciliation spreadsheet so we can batch credits next week.
Rina (Finance Director): good plan. Keep thread updated when dedupe-scan completes.
Maya (Billing): resolving NOVA case for now; will update CM amount after final SRE report.
